# polygons.types: Polygon2D

**Status:** Supported (tier `geometry`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> A simple closed polygon: Points are the boundary vertices in order, the last
> implicitly joined to the first. Invariants: at least three vertices, no edge
> crossings; counter-clockwise winding encloses positive area.
> (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simple\_polygon)

//==
// # Polygons

// Sections, in order:
//  - Polygons in the plane

//==
// # Polygons in the plane
//
// Point-list regions of the plane (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polygon): the simple
// polygon, its strictly convex refinement, the region with holes, the multi-polygon
// set Boolean operations return, and the regular star. Winding convention:
// counter-clockwise boundaries enclose positive area; holes wind opposite to the
// boundary that contains them.

// A simple closed polygon: Points are the boundary vertices in order, the last
// implicitly joined to the first. Invariants: at least three vertices, no edge
// crossings; counter-clockwise winding encloses positive area.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simple_polygon)
type Polygon2D
    implements IGeometry2D, IClosedShape, IConnected, IArea, IBounded2D, IPointSet2D, ICentroid2D, IContainsPoint2D, INearestPoint2D, IDeformable2D, IMesh2D
{
    Points: Array<Point2D>;
}
